subject: Clarification needed: Invoice INV-1700 – Additional User Charges
text:
Dear Arisha,

Hope all is well with you.

We recently received the invoice for additional users on our account. After reviewing the charges, the amounts do not align with our internal records, and we need some clarifications.

Could you please provide information on the following:

• 

User Definition & Calculation: What is the specific definition of a "billable user"? Specifically, are we charged for all registered accounts or only those active within a certain timeframe? Please provide a detailed list of the users included in this invoice and the calculation used to reach the total.

• 

Notification of Overages: Moving forward, we need to be notified in advance of any overages before they are billed. Does your system provide automated alerts when we approach our seat limit, or can we set a hard cap to prevent unexpected charges?

• 

Viewer Mode Inquiry: Does your platform offer a "Viewer" or "Read-Only" role? We have several users who do not require full access. If this role exists, please let us know the pricing structure, as it may be more appropriate for our needs.

We want to ensure our account is managed efficiently and that there are no further billing surprises. I look forward to receiving the user list and your feedback on these points.

Best regards,

Inbal

-- 

Inbal Friedlander, DataOperations Team Leader

subject: Re: AWL + Encord
text:
Dear Arisha,

Happy New Year! I hope you had a restful holiday season.

I’m following up on my message from late December and kindly checking in.
To ensure we are fully aligned, may I confirm the following points?

• Full suspension in March and April 2026:
  No platform usage and no payment obligations during this period.

• User access during suspension:
  The two accounts (dataimporter11+awl@gmail.com and guest+awl@encord.com) were set up by Encord at project start.
  As they were not created by us, we are unable to modify or disable them on our side during the suspension.

• Resumption window for the remaining three months:
  Our current plan is to use the service in May, June, and July 2026 (starting around May 1).
  Depending on the government subsidy approval timing, the window may shift
  (e.g., June–August). We would appreciate flexibility to adjust the contract and invoice schedule accordingly.

• Deferred payment:
  Thank you again for accommodating the deferment of the remaining USD 12,500
  until after the subsidy is approved.

If everything above looks good, could you kindly share a brief confirmation by next week?
Alternatively, I’m happy to jump on a short 20–30 minute call to finalize the suspension/admin details.

Please let me know if another time works better.

Thank you very much for your continued support.
Warm regards,

Mina Tsuchida
AWL, Inc.
